description.value: Umi Sushi Express is a Canadian quick-service Japanese food franchise operating over 30 locations nationwide, with this outpost on downtown Victoria's main commercial corridor. The concept focuses on fresh, healthy sushi and Japanese cuisine made quickly for customers on the go. It is one of three banners in the Umi family, which also includes Umi Teriyaki & Sushi.
